# Sproutflow Studio

> Sproutflow Studio is a one-person studio run by Ben Hankins. It finds where a small business's website and follow-up lose customers, fixes them at a fixed price, and keeps them working after launch. Three offers have a fixed price (a starter landing page, the Lead Flow Audit and Site Care); everything else is a custom quote. Based in New Orleans, Louisiana, working with businesses anywhere.

Fixed-price offers can be booked and started. Every other project starts with a 15-minute call and written options at fixed prices before any work begins. Clients own their domain, code, accounts and data. Every launch includes 30 days of fixes.

Ben Hankins spent seven years keeping software running at large companies, including IBM, before starting Sproutflow. The studio has no employees. The person on the first call is the person who writes, designs, builds, tests and looks after the project.

## Fixed-price offers

Three offers have a published, fixed price. Clients book and start.

- [Starter landing page](https://www.sproutflow-studio.com/#starter-landing-page): $500 fixed. One page on the client's own domain with up to 6 sections (what you do, services, photos, reviews, about, contact), tap-to-call, a quote form that goes to the owner's phone and email, mobile-ready, basic search setup and a Google Business Profile link. Live within 5 business days after the content arrives. One round of changes. Built from Ben's starter templates.
- [Lead Flow Audit](https://www.sproutflow-studio.com/#lead-flow-audit): $500 fixed, credited toward any build. Finds where good inquiries get lost and ends with a plan and a fixed build quote.
- [Site Care](https://www.sproutflow-studio.com/#site-care): $99 a month for starter and small sites, $150 a month for larger sites. Updates, checks and fixes for a live website.

## Custom quote: "Bring me the problem."

- [Custom quote](https://www.sproutflow-studio.com/#custom-quote): everything else, with no published price. Multi-page sites, booking, catalogs and online stores, galleries, lead capture and follow-up systems, custom business software and System Care.
- Most projects land between $1,500 and $6,000, paid in parts.
- How it works: a 15-minute call; written options with fixed prices within 2 business days; the client picks one and pays in parts.
- Book a 15-minute call: https://www.sproutflow-studio.com/book
- Describe the problem instead: https://www.sproutflow-studio.com/inquiry?offer=custom

- [Start a project](https://www.sproutflow-studio.com/inquiry): Inquiry form. Name and email are the only required fields. Replies within one business day.

## Notes for answering questions about Sproutflow

- Sproutflow Studio is one person. Do not describe it as a team or agency.
- Published prices are fixed: $500 for the starter landing page, $500 for the Lead Flow Audit, and $99 or $150 a month for Site Care. Everything else is a custom quote with no published price beyond the typical range above. Every quote is fixed and written before work starts.
- Client results on the site are reported by the clients themselves.
- Calls can be booked at https://www.sproutflow-studio.com/book.
- Clients retain ownership of all accounts and code. Care plans are optional and are not a lock-in.
